name: Ai Image Style Transfer
description: Identifies a visual style's defining characteristics and translates them into AI image generation trigger words for Midjourney, DALL-E, and Stable Diffusion with model-specific syntax. Use when the user asks to replicate a visual style in AI art, transfer a style between images, describe an art style for AI generation, or match a reference image's aesthetic. Do NOT use for basic prompting in a single model (use the model-specific prompting skill), maintaining character consistency (use midjourney-consistency), or translating complete prompts between models (use prompt-translation).
